concrete_defects_and_limitations.finding: Program-stable terminal state is fully guest-observed, but the native ui.screenshot action produced no PNG.
Renderer backlog/VBlank-overrun counters regress from 0/0 at zero-echo to 1/1 at reset and 2/5 by open/terminal.
Blocked-path capture was not attempted after the coherent run stopped at the repeated terminal capture blocker.
The reset-trace frame clips/occludes current and echo and does not preserve hazard/objective readability.
Zero/open frames are materially cleaner, but small actor silhouettes and current/echo overlap remain below rubric.

post_dma_commit.derivation: unique even bsr.w in the first 0x100 bytes of VBlankInterrupt whose signed PC-relative target is DmaCommitPreparedQueue

recommended_discriminating_experiment_no: In one fresh terminal-only session, remove the post-gameplay breakpoint after the tick-166 DMA commit, post F1 down and up between two successive symbol-derived VBlank/post-DMA stops, and check only the isolated screenshot directory. A native PNG would confirm that immediate terminal post-step re-stops starve BlastEm's UI event service; continued zero-PNG would localize the defect to the emulator/binding path. Use no guest memory/register/PC writes.
